Bounded T44 E–H handoff proof for existing T3 wN:p6; no execution dispatch.

Read the candidate docs/reviews/briefs/t44-streams.md at immutable coordinator 749e5c7f2df2c8444b07f8521493d12b7f7a962b, proved v2 base brief, full #691/#1413/#1414 and the retained P1 D support report plus root comparison results under docs/qa-logs/2026-11-02-m6-resume/t44-stage-d/. T44 D is 923dd5371ded83fa965449a83f7a16d15a174772; ES55158/root64b90 stays read-only.

Prove the handoff as an unfamiliar executor: exact paths exist, PL-001's documentation criterion matches the specified carry/rationale/revisit outcome, all five backlog routes and existing owners agree, four provenance qualifications stay historical, and E/F/G/H ownership/custody/gates are concrete and nonconflicting. Check new current-program binding against retained old/current bytes and the H named census/receipt interface. Return concrete contradictions or missing operational inputs, not optional editorial expansion.

At most ten top-level commands, immutable Git/API reads and small private metadata scratch only. Reuse the accepted membership and controls; no source audit, source export/clone, producer/parser/generator/test/cleanup execution, cache/process/private-held inspection, repository/kit/tracker/shared-ref write, runtime/provider/device/cloud action or permission answer. This records-only supplement introduces no source membership or producer run to re-prove. CPUs 8–23 throughout. Historical T41 tree remains unchanged. Return concise report with exact commands/hashes to wN:p2, then stop. Root retains decisions, corrections, planning and dispatch.
